Ram Mandir Donation Allegations Spark Political Debate and Investigations

Allegations of embezzlement concerning donations for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya have surfaced, leading to political criticism and ongoing investigations. Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal and Congress leader Digvijaya Singh have demanded action against trust officials. The BJP has responded by accusing opposition parties of appeasement politics. An SIT is reportedly investigating the matter, with reports of lawyers refusing to defend the accused.
